The man is barefoot and wears black boxing gloves, executing punch combinations. The gym is large with treadmills, weight racks, and overhead fluorescent lighting. (3) Transition to the woman hitting pads held by the man from the first scene. She is wearing a light blue t-shirt and red boxing gloves. They are in a section of the gym with mirrors and heavy hanging bags. (4) The woman, now in a grey hoodie and black leggings, hits pads held by the trainer. The setting shows more boxing equipment like gloves on shelves and hanging bags. (5) Cut to the man in the black t-shirt performing boxing drills with the trainer. The camera captures a full shot of his movements on the padded floor. (6) A rapid montage shows the woman in the grey hoodie hitting pads very fast. Her hair is tied back and she displays intense focus and energy. (7) The video ends with a black screen showing a red 'Like' icon being clicked, followed by two golden bells and the text 'Bobo TV'.
